paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Mari. See the entry R' Yitzchak Kaskasa’a.[^1]

notes.text: קסקסאה completes the target name across the line break. Kaskasa’a is a conventional vocalization; its interpretation as an epithet or place designation remains uncertain. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
